messages:
anya: Quick ask — need a small cohort rerun for the launch webinar claim. We want p50/p95 latency + cost delta for fp16 vs quantized variants. High priority for slides. S3 manifest: s3://redwood-marketing/bench/cohort_A/manifest.csv. Please run coldstart + 5 warmup reps per config and attach raw traces and CSVs.

mike: Got it. Which model family, sequence lengths, and concurrency targets? Also, do you want embedding latency captured?

anya: model: redwood/open-4b. Variants: fp16, quant8 (and fp8 if available). Seq lenses: 2048 typical, include 4096 tail. Concurrency: interactive => 1, and a multi-concurrency run at 8. Warmups: 5 each. Yes include embed latency bucket if the pipeline touches embeddings. Manifest has prompts + expected lengths.

mike: Pls confirm the exact CLI/env you want us to use. I'll queue the job once I have the command.

anya: use this run command (put results under the path below):
```
./bench/run_infer.sh \
  --model redwood/open-4b \
  --variants fp16,quant8,fp8 \
  --cohort s3://redwood-marketing/bench/cohort_A/manifest.csv \
  --concurrency 1,8 \
  --seq 2048,4096 \
  --warmups 5 \
  --collect-traces true \
  --artifact-path s3://redwood-marketing/bench/results/4442109876/
```

sara: Can you also export a metric for token-cost-estimate per 1k requests? Marketing slide needs cost delta numbers (absolute and %). Also please include coldstart penalty numbers separately.

ben: If fp8 isn't available, add an int8 fallback config. Also record sampling settings (top_k/top_p) used for each run. That affects latency variance.

deploybot: bench-runner scheduled job id=br-444210 triggered by @mike :gear:

mike: Starting the sweep now. Will run concurrency=1 sweep first, then concurrency=8. ETA ~25m. Posting progress.

mike: Progress update: finished fp16 2048 conc=1 (1/6). Quick stats: p50=47ms, p95=118ms. Saving intermediate artifacts.

mike: Mid-run note — quant8 shows slightly higher p95 on 4096 sequences, seeing tail amplification during KV cache warmup. Capturing full traces.

mike: Run complete. Artifacts uploaded: s3://redwood-marketing/bench/results/4442109876/summary.json and CSVs in same folder. Quick summary table (slide-ready):
- fp16 | seq=2048 | conc=1 | p50=47ms | p95=118ms | cost=$0.0020 per token-equivalent
- quant8 | seq=2048 | conc=1 | p50=52ms | p95=165ms | cost=-22% vs fp16
- fp16 | seq=4096 | conc=8 | p50=65ms | p95=320ms | coldstart penalty ~+90ms
Notes: quant8 reduces cost but increases tail latency on very long contexts; warmup mitigates some coldstart impact. Full CSVs + raw trace samples uploaded.

anya: Awesome — exactly what we need. Can you export a small slide table (p50/p95/cost-delta for the three primary rows) and attach an example raw trace for the 4096 quant8 coldstart case? Need by EOD for speaker prep. :pray:

mike: Done — uploaded slide_table_444210.csv and sample_trace_4096_quant8.jsonl to the artifacts folder. Marking this thread resolved. :white_check_mark:
